newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Bunds to take heart from 101.50 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Bunds to take heart from 101.50 support.

text.p: June Bund futures on LIFFE will rely on a collection of supports around 101.50 on Tuesday to prevent a major decline but are unlikely to get far ahead of a key policy meeting of the U.S. central bank, analysts said.
"We've got this support line which has been there since the beginning of April," Marc Ostwald, technical strategist at London Bond Broking here.

Ostwald said the trendline comes in around 101.49 this session. He added the contract will also glean support around here from 101.48, the high from 1994 on monthly continuation charts and around 101.36, the high from 1996 on monthly charts.
"I would imagine we would have a bit of a test of those but it might be quite thin today so it could have a small bounce," Ostwald said.
The U.S. Federal Reserve's policy making committee meets to discuss interest rates, with market players divided over the possibility of a rise. A decision, if any, was expected around 1815 GMT.
Bunds were quoted at 101.62 at 0713 GMT, up eight basis points from Monday.
Any bounce higher would be met with resistance at heavy congestion around 101.82,90, Ostwald said.
Daily charts show the contract bumping up against highs around 101.90 at the beginning of May before spurting higher.
Above there, the contract would aim for congestion around the lows of 102.05 and 102.10 from May 13 to 15, Ostwald said.
Analysts said a close below the trendline around 101.50 would produce a more serious correction.

"But for now, Bunds are positive above 101.50 with mild value area resistance at 101.80,90, the comfort zone for early trading on Monday," technical analysts at Royal Bank of Scotland said in a research note.
Ostwald said if the trendline broke below 101.50, Bunds would target 101.02,07, levels around the highs of the middle of April.
September Euromarks were quoted at 96.74, up one basis point, at 0733 GMT.
